text.Brain World:
How to Play Edit ==
When you play the Brain World you get the ability to scrap up to two cards from your hand and / or discard pile. Draw a card for each card scrapped this way. The Brain World is an Outpost with a defense of 6. 
 Strategy Edit ==
This is the Outpost everbody wants. Scrapping unwanted cards and drawing up new cards breaths out sheer Power and with a defense of 6 you can have some hope it lives another turn.
